thesis: The episode introduces Jeff Housenbold, a managing director at SoftBank Investment Advisors who led one of the six teams deploying the $100 billion SoftBank Vision Fund, and outlines his career path from Wall Street and strategy consulting to operating roles at eBay and Shutterfly. The conversation begins by exploring Housenbold's background, including his upbringing in Brooklyn, his first-generation college experience, and his transition from working various entry-level jobs to becoming a venture capitalist.
